'''Grumm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and a honor-brother of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gorro]]. The two lived in the town of [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3637 BBY]] Gorro mistook a powerful off-worlder for a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang leader thanks to the machinations of [[Lana Beniko]] and foolishly challenged them to a fight, which resulted in his death. Grumm swore revenge and confronted Gorro's killer at the streets of Raider's Cove. However, just like Gorro, he was defeated.

==Behind the scenes==
Grumm's first and only appearance is in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''.

Players can kill Grumm as a dark side option.
